    <script>
  (function() {
    document.documentElement.classList.add('js-enabled');

    var allowedModes = { light: true, dark: true, system: true };

    var storedTheme = localStorage.getItem('theme');
    var storedMode = localStorage.getItem('mode');
    var forcedModeAttr = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-force-mode');
    var forcedMode = (forcedModeAttr === 'light' || forcedModeAttr === 'dark') ? forcedModeAttr : null;

    var theme = 'default';
    if (storedTheme !== 'default') {
      localStorage.setItem('theme', 'default');
    }
    var mode = forcedMode || (allowedModes[storedMode] ? storedMode : 'dark');
    var resolvedMode = mode;

    if (!forcedMode && mode === 'system') {
      resolvedMode = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? 'dark' : 'light';
    }

    var backgroundColor = resolvedMode === 'dark' ? 'hsl(20 14.3% 4.1%)' : 'hsl(0 0% 100%)';

    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-mode', resolvedMode);
    document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = resolvedMode;
    document.documentElement.style.backgroundColor = backgroundColor;

    if (resolvedMode === 'dark') {
      document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');
    } else {
      document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');
    }
  })();
</script>

      <script>
    (function() {
      const reloadAttemptKey = 'kapso-vite-reload-attempted-at';
      const reloadCooldownMs = 60 * 1000;

      function reloadOnce(event) {
        const lastReloadAttempt = Number(window.sessionStorage.getItem(reloadAttemptKey) || 0);
        const currentTime = Date.now();

        if (currentTime - lastReloadAttempt < reloadCooldownMs) return;

        event.preventDefault();
        window.sessionStorage.setItem(reloadAttemptKey, currentTime.toString());
        window.location.reload();
      }

      function viteAssetUrl(target) {
        if (target instanceof HTMLScriptElement) return target.src;
        if (target instanceof HTMLLinkElement) return target.href;

        return '';
      }

      function isViteAssetUrl(url) {
        return url && new URL(url, window.location.href).pathname.startsWith('/vite/assets/');
      }

      window.addEventListener('vite:preloadError', reloadOnce);
      window.addEventListener('error', function(event) {
        if (isViteAssetUrl(viteAssetUrl(event.target))) reloadOnce(event);
      }, true);
    })();
  </script>

    <script>
      (function() {
        var privacyContextElement = document.getElementById('kapso-privacy-preferences-context');
        var privacyContext = privacyContextElement ? JSON.parse(privacyContextElement.textContent) : {};
        var advertisingAllowed = privacyContext.advertising_allowed === true &&
          navigator.globalPrivacyControl !== true;
        var baseKeys = ['utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_content', 'utm_term'];
        var advertisingKeys = [
          'gclid', 'gbraid', 'wbraid', 'fbclid', 'msclkid', 'ttclid', 'li_fat_id', 'rdt_cid',
          'twclid', 'x_ad_id', 'x_campaign_id', 'x_line_item_id',
          'x_tweet_id', 'x_creative', 'x_country'
        ];
        var currentParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        var isXCampaign = currentParams.get('utm_source') &&
          currentParams.get('utm_source').toLowerCase() === 'x';

        function updateSignupLink(link) {
          var url = new URL(link.href, window.location.href);
          if (url.pathname !== '/users/sign_up') {
            return;
          }

          var deniedAdvertisingKeys = isXCampaign ? advertisingKeys.concat(baseKeys) : advertisingKeys;
          var allowedKeys = advertisingAllowed ? baseKeys.concat(advertisingKeys) :
            (isXCampaign ? [] : baseKeys);
          allowedKeys.forEach(function(key) {
            var value = currentParams.get(key);
            if (!url.searchParams.has(key)) {
              if (value) {
                url.searchParams.set(key, value);
              }
            }
          });

          if (!advertisingAllowed) {
            deniedAdvertisingKeys.forEach(function(key) {
              url.searchParams.delete(key);
            });
          }

          link.href = url.toString();
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('a[href]').forEach(updateSignupLink);
        document.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
          var link = event.target.closest && event.target.closest('a[href]');
          if (link) {
            updateSignupLink(link);
          }
        }, true);

        window.addEventListener('kapso:privacy-preferences-changed', function(event) {
          advertisingAllowed = event.detail.advertisingAllowed === true &&
            navigator.globalPrivacyControl !== true;
          document.querySelectorAll('a[href]').forEach(updateSignupLink);
        });
      })();
    </script>
